_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to go on tearing itself for as long as it exists, and how
far that goes (design 5.2.1). Dearer than a wound, because a wound is a hole the Age was written
with and this is the Age never stopping -- the register a player cannot outlast, only leave. Each
step bought makes the density climb faster with the Age's age; `most` bounds the RATE, never the
final state, which is deliberately unbounded.
